# AI Context Bridge

> A free, open-source browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) that sends content from Reddit, Medium, or ChatGPT straight into Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini with one click, instead of copy-pasting. Runs entirely locally: no server, no analytics, no tracking.

## What it does

- Reddit thread → Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or clipboard
- Medium article → Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or clipboard
- ChatGPT conversation → Claude (summarize & continue, or a second opinion)
- Time Awareness: tells the AI how long it's been since the last message (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini)
- Ambient Sounds and Default Model preference (Claude.ai only)

- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ai-context-bridge/kjgmboacclalfjgcmooplnpimjalikfo)
- [Microsoft Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/jfnfbefcfahohimpnbelabdbohimlmfi)
- [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/ai-context-bridge/)

## Pricing

Free. No paid tiers, no account, no signup required.
